      • initializeEngine

        public void initializeEngine(SSEngineParam param)
                      throws SSException
        Initialize the SecuSearch Engine with a set of its user setting parameters.

        This function checks the validity of the license file, allocates memory for the internal in-memory fingerprint database, and initializes global variables.

        Please note that you should call initializeEngine(SSEngineParam) once before calling any other functions except terminateEngine() and getVersion(). Otherwise, they throw an SSException whose errorCode is SSErrorCode.NOT_INIT.

        Parameters:
        param - a SSEngineParam object containing the user setting parameters of the SecuSearch engine.
        Throws:
        SSException - if it fails. You can check out the reason by calling SSException.getErrorCode()
        See Also:
        SSEngineParam, terminateEngine()

      • terminateEngine

        public void terminateEngine()
                     throws SSException
        Terminates SecuSearch Engine. When an application do not need the SecuSearch engine any more or exits, it should be called. This function frees all the memory that the SecuSearch Engine has allocated.
        Throws:
        SSException - if it fails. You can check out the reason by calling SSException.getErrorCode()
        See Also:
        initializeEngine(SSEngineParam)

      • registerFP

        public boolean registerFP(byte[] sgTemplate,
                 int templateId)
                   throws SSException
        Registers fingerprint template.

        Inputs 400-byte fingerprint minutiae template extracted by FDx SDK Pro and template ID to register a fingerprint to the internal memory resident fingerprint database of the SecuSearch Engine

        Parameters:
        sgTemplate - a byte array that contains a SecuGen 400-byte fingerprint template
        templateId - an ID of a fingerprint template to be registered.
        Returns:
        true only if the template with the ID is newly registered. false if the ID is already registered so that the template is not registered.
        Throws:
        SSException - if it fails due to an exceptional reason. You can check out the reason by calling SSException.getErrorCode()
        See Also:
        registerFPBatch(SSIdTemplatePair[]), removeFP(int), getTemplate(int)

      • registerFPBatch

        public boolean registerFPBatch(SSIdTemplatePair[] pairs)
                        throws SSException
        Registers fingerprint templates in a batch.

        All the internal SecuSearch engines concurrently register the given templates so that the registration speed can much faster than the speed of calling RegisterFP multiple times, especially in cases with a large batch count such as 256.

        Parameters:
        pairs - an array of SSIdTemplatePair object which contains an ID and a 400-byte fingerprint template.
        Returns:
        true only if all the ID in the pairs are newly registered. false if any of IDs in the pairs is already registered. all the pairs are not registered at all when it returns false.
        Throws:
        SSException - if it fails due to an exceptional reason. You can check out the reason by calling SSException.getErrorCode()
        See Also:
        registerFP(byte[], int), removeFPBatch(int[])

      • searchFP

        public SSCandidate[] searchFP(byte[] sgTemplate)
                       throws SSException
        Searches for matching fingerprint candidates in the SecuSearch database that are similar to the input 400-byte template extracted by FDx SDK Pro.

        The returned candidates are listed in descending order of matching score that quantifies the degree of similarity between the compared fingerprints. If the confidence level is above 5, it can be regarded that the two fingerprints match.

        Parameters:
        sgTemplate - a byte array which contains a SecuGen 400-byte fingerprint template. Note that its length should be 400 in bytes.
        Returns:
        an array of SSCandidate objects, which are listed in descending order of their matchingScores. If no candidate is found, it returns an empty array whose lenth is zero.
        Throws:
        SSException - if it fails due to an exceptional reason. You can check out the reason by calling SSException.getErrorCode()
        See Also:
        SSCandidate

      • identifyFP

        public int identifyFP(byte[] sgTemplate,
             SSConfLevel minConfLevel)
               throws SSException
        Identifies an input (query) fingerprint with a SecuGen 400-byte fingerprint minutiae template.

        This function determines whether there is a fingerprint in the SecuSearch memory resident database that matches the input fingerprint.

        If a matching fingerprint is found, this function returns an identified template ID. Otherwise, this function returns INVALID_TEMPLATE_ID.

        The minConfLevel is a threshold that is used to decide whether two fingerprints match. The minConfLevel can be set to a value from SSConfLevel.LOWEST to SSConfLevel.HIGHEST. If it is set to SSConfLevel.HIGH, identification will succeed only when there is a high degree of correlation between the minutiae points of the two fingerprints.

        Parameters:
        sgTemplate - a byte array which contains a SecuGen 400-byte fingerprint template. Note that its length should be 400 in bytes.
        minConfLevel - the minimum level of SSConfLevel to be accepted.
        Returns:
        an identified template ID if a matching fingerprint is found. Otherwise, it returns INVALID_TEMPLATE_ID.
        Throws:
        SSException - if it fails due to an exceptional reason. You can check out the reason by calling SSException.getErrorCode()

      • extractTemplate

        public byte[] extractTemplate(byte[] standardTemplate,
                     SSTemplateType templateType,
                     int indexOfView)
                       throws SSException
        Extracts a single finger view from a standard template in the ANSI 378 or ISO 19794 format, and returns a fingerprint template which is converted in the SecuGen 400-byte template format.

        The returned byte array of a fingerprint template can be used by the SecuSearch engine to register, search, or identify.

        You can get the total count of finger views in a standard template by calling getNumberOfView(byte[], SSTemplateType)

        Parameters:
        standardTemplate - a byte array containing a standard fingerprint template in the ANSI 378 or ISO 19794 format.
        templateType - the template type of standardTemplate. The valid values are SSTemplateType.ANSI378 or SSTemplateType.ISO19794.
        indexOfView - an integer index value which specifies a finger view to extract, as a zero-based index inside the given standard_template.
        Returns:
        a byte array of an extracted fingerprint template in the SecuGen 400-byte template format
        Throws:
        SSException - if it fails. You can check out the reason by calling SSException.getErrorCode()
        See Also:
        getNumberOfView(byte[], SSTemplateType), registerFP(byte[], int), searchFP(byte[]), identifyFP(byte[], SSConfLevel)

      • getNumberOfView

        public int getNumberOfView(byte[] standardTemplate,
                  SSTemplateType templateType)
                    throws SSException
        Gets the total number of finger views in a standard fingerprint template as in the ANSI 378 or ISO 19794 format

        The supported values of templateType are SSTemplateType.ANSI378 and SSTemplateType.ISO19794. Calling with the other values cause it to throw an SSException whose errorCode is SSErrorCode.INVALID_PARAM.

        Parameters:
        standardTemplate - a byte array containing a standard fingerprint template in the ANSI 378 or ISO 19794 format.
        templateType - the template type of standardTemplate. The valid values are SSTemplateType.ANSI378 or SSTemplateType.ISO19794.
        Returns:
        the total count of finger views which the standardTemplate contains
        Throws:
        SSException - if it fails. You can check out the reason by calling SSException.getErrorCode()
        See Also:
        extractTemplate(byte[], SSTemplateType, int)

      • getVersion

        public String getVersion()
        Gets the version string in the format: "Major.Minor.Revision".

        For example, it returns "3.1.2" when the major version is 3, the minor version is 1, and the revision number is 2.

        Please note that getVersion() can be called regardless of calling initializeEngine(SSEngineParam).

        Returns:
        a version string in the format: "Major.Minor.Revision"
